note: the playstyle vocabulary. Community-named Commander playstyles as detectable compositions of oracle_signals. Names and exemplars are sourced; inventing neither. An entry with missing_signals cannot be detected until those signals exist — that is a finding, not a match.

aristocrats.name: aristocrats
aristocrats.says: Sacrifice your own creatures for value, then cash in the deaths.

not.blink: Both move creatures on and off the battlefield. Aristocrats wants them to DIE and stay dead for value; blink wants them to COME BACK to re-trigger enters.

missing_signals: dies_trigger_doubler — Teysa Karlov doubles death triggers without saying 'dies' in a way our dies_trigger pattern catches

blink.name: blink
blink.says: Exile your own creatures and bring them back to reuse their enter-the-battlefield abilities.

not.aristocrats: Both clear your board of creatures. Blink returns them to fire enters again; aristocrats needs the death itself as the resource.

missing_signals: etb_doubler — Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines doubles enters without blinking anything herself
leaves_payoff_for_blink — Hei Bai pays you when he leaves; the community blinks him for that, but leaves_battlefield alone is not the blink action

counters.name: +1/+1 counters
counters.says: Stack +1/+1 counters on your creatures and turn that growth into the win.

not.voltron: Both make one creature huge. Counters grow any creature you choose and often a whole team; voltron suits up one body — usually the commander — with equipment and auras for commander damage.

voltron.name: voltron
voltron.says: Pile equipment and auras on one creature — usually your commander — and win with commander damage.

not.counters: Both aim at a lethal attacker. Voltron is gear on one body for commander damage; counters is the +1/+1 counter engine, which can go tall or wide without caring about equipment.

spellslinger.name: spellslinger
spellslinger.says: Cast a pile of instants and sorceries and get paid every time you do.

not.reanimator: Both dig the graveyard. Spellslinger casts instants and sorceries from hand (and sometimes yard); reanimator cheats fat creatures onto the battlefield from the yard.

landfall.name: landfall
landfall.says: Every land that enters the battlefield under you pays you again.

not.tokens: Landfall often makes tokens, but the engine is the land entering. Tokens is about the army itself; a token deck does not need lands to keep entering.

tokens.name: tokens
tokens.says: Make a wide board of creature tokens and overwhelm with numbers.

not.aristocrats: Both love cheap creatures. Tokens wants them alive on board for go-wide damage; aristocrats wants them dying for value.

missing_signals: token_doubler — Chatterfang replaces token creation with extra Squirrels; creature_token_maker never fires because he never says 'create'

reanimator.name: reanimator
reanimator.says: Put big creatures in the graveyard, then cheaply put them onto the battlefield.

not.aristocrats: Both use the graveyard. Reanimator wants the creature BACK as a threat; aristocrats wants the death trigger and is fine if the body stays gone.

stax.name: stax
stax.says: Tax and lock the table so opponents cannot play their game while you still can.

not.group_hug: Both change how much everyone gets to do. Stax takes resources away asymmetrically; group hug gives everyone extras and wins through the politics that creates.

group_hug.name: group hug
group_hug.says: Give the whole table extra cards and mana, then win through the chaos and politics that creates.

not.stax: Both are table-wide effects. Group hug gives; stax takes. The table feels the difference immediately.

lifegain.name: lifegain
lifegain.says: Gain life over and over, then turn that life into cards, creatures, or drains.

not.aristocrats: Both often drain life. Lifegain wants the gain event as fuel; aristocrats wants the death event. A drain payoff can sit in either deck for different reasons.

missing_signals: gained_life_this_turn — Lathiel keys off 'if you gained life this turn' and has lifelink; lifegain_trigger never fires

artifacts.name: artifacts
artifacts.says: Build around artifacts — rocks, constructs, and machines that feed each other.

not.tokens: Artifact decks often make Construct or Thopter tokens. Artifacts is about the permanent type and its synergies; tokens is about the wide board regardless of type.

tribal.name: tribal
tribal.says: Pick a creature type and fill the deck with that type so every lord and payoff hits.

not.tokens: Tribal can make tokens of its type. Tribal needs the creature type to matter; a generic token swarm with no type payoff is tokens, not tribal.
